column2: conditional-load filtering only handles simple `if`/`when` or bullet forms, so branch-only routing-table rows and related route contexts can be counted as always-loaded closure.
collecting every markdown path on a matching directive line can count explanatory citations or harness docs as always-loaded files even when only one referenced file is part of the read directive.
line-level conditional filtering may still count unconditional-looking reads inside non-happy-path macro sections. that can add failure-only files to the `/implement` happy-path closure baseline.
